rules.title: Prohibition on requiring drug or alcohol tests or drug abuse treatment information
rules.requirement: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request the applicant’s consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords cannot require you to take drug or alcohol tests or ask for your drug abuse treatment records when you apply.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios no pueden exigirle que se someta a pruebas de drogas o alcohol ni solicitar sus registros de tratamiento por abuso de drogas al solicitar una vivienda.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all housing providers and applicants in New Jersey.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request the applicant’s consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.

rules.title: Eviction allowed after successful appeal overturning discrimination finding
rules.requirement: If a housing provider successfully appeals a director's decision finding a violation of the act and the court overturns the decision, the housing provider may evict the former applicant residing in the unit with at least 45 days' notice.
rules.summary_plain: If a landlord wins an appeal overturning a discrimination ruling, they can evict the tenant who got the unit because of that ruling, but must give 45 days' notice.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si un propietario gana una apelación que revoca un fallo de discriminación, puede desalojar al inquilino que obtuvo la unidad por ese fallo, pero debe dar un aviso de 45 días.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies when a housing provider successfully appeals a director's decision under this act and the tenant resides in the unit as a result of that decision.
rules.quoted_span: if an appeal by a housing provider is successful, and the court overturns a final decision of the director that resulted in an order under this paragraph, then a determination that the housing provider did not violate the provisions of this act as evidenced by such successful appeal shall be grounds for the housing provider to evict the former applicant if that person resides in a rental dwelling unit owned by the housing provider as the result of the director’s order, so long as the housing provider provides the applicant with at least 45 days’ notice prior to the eviction
